notes.title: ChessBlaze 1.3 Is here!
notes.content:
[h1]ChessBlaze 1.3 is released![/h1][p]Version 1.2 focused on menu, now its time to update the game itself!
ChessBlaze 1.3 will rework the UI of the game, for it to be more immersive and readable.[/p][p]Also, the single-player finally got all the modes![/p][p]Here is the new logo for the game:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257659/58f6022d6927592ee2bf8be7260b42a3bf3461a2.png"][/img][/p][h2]New reworked in-game UI[/h2][p]New UI will focus on presenting energy more clearly as well as adding other important aspects of the game like captured pieces, move history or sounds indicators.[/p][p]You can also decide if you want to see enrgy on the right or left in the settings[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257659/8860490414f5656f7cb8073fc3d3cbb3f87aeb26.png"][/img][/p][h2]Single-player improvements[/h2][p]Power mode and Madness are finally available in Single-player![/p][p]Diversified bot difficulties, improved late-game strategies and energy optimization of the bots.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257659/176887b374d804323a1e9c0e6ec6bb5a40c2acb0.png"][/img][/p][h2]New Skins[/h2][h3]Glass Pieces and Glass Chessboard[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257659/3c235b9ead0ae45e41249537315494b83ae9a880.png"][/img][/p][h3]Chessboards Chessboard [/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257659/ccb241171d8b502d3467106b6cab45fb55389edb.png"][/img][/p][p]Chromatic Pieces[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257659/afff18ac54f78f46998b7b377d69bb07eb400549.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][p]King no longer destroys barriers placed by rooks[/p][p]pieces cant no longer disappear without reason on rare occasions[/p][p]Sound doesn't glitch in menu if you play too many sounds[/p][p]Resolved "Shadow capture" where once per hundred's of games there was a chance for a piece to be forgotten by the chessboard, but not captured in the process.[/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: ChessBlaze 1.2 Update is live now!
notes.content:
[h1]♟ ChessBlaze 1.2 – Content Update ♟[/h1][p]

After a few months since version 1.1, we're excited to announce a [b]major new update[/b] to [b]ChessBlaze[/b]!

[b]Update 1.2[/b] is bigger than ever—packed with new content, revamped systems, and a ton of fixes to improve your experience.   [/p][p][/p][h2]Menu Redesign[/h2][p]The old menu is gone! (almost gone)[/p][p]The [b]new interface[/b] is more intuitive and visually appealing. Key improvements include: [/p][list][*][p][b]Expanded Settings[/b] options  [/p][/*][*][p][b]Skin Selection[/b] improvements  [/p][/*][*][p]Completely rebuilt [b]Custom Lobby Creation[/b] tools  [/p][/*][*][p][b]Steam Friend Integration[/b] – Invite friends directly via Steam!   [/p][/*][/list][h2][/h2][h2]Upgraded Single-player Mode[/h2][p]The AI has received a major overhaul—now faster, more stable, and smarter (but don’t worry, the easier bots are still beatable!). [/p][p]Several [b]Multiplayer game modes[/b] are now available in Single-player.  [/p][p][b]Power Mode[/b] is not available in Single-player yet, but we’re working on it for a future update.  [/p][p] [/p][h2]Language Support Completed[/h2][h3] All in-game content is now fully translated into: [/h3][list][*][p]  🇩🇪 [b]German[/b][/p][/*][*][p]  🇵🇱 [b]Polish[/b][/p][/*][*][p]  🇯🇵 [b]Japanese[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]We also fixed numerous typos and mistranslations.  If any still sneak through, we’ll catch them in upcoming updates. [/p][p]More languages are planned in the future![/p][p][/p][h2]New Game Modes[/h2][h3]
Two [b]brand new game modes[/b] are now live in both Single-player and Multiplayer:   [/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]Blaze Mode[/p][list][*][p]Introduces [b]Energy Tiles: [/b]Step on one to [b]regenerate energy[/b] and [b]reduce cooldown[/b] for your piece’s next move [/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][p]Shape-shift Mode[/p][list][*][p][b]Capture = Transform[/b]  [/p][/*][*][p]Your piece transforms into whatever it captures  [/p][/*][*][p]One of our most chaotic modes yet!   [/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]New Visual Tutorial[/h2][p]
We’ve replaced our placeholder tutorial with a new [b]visual walkthrough[/b]. [/p][p] It’s not perfect yet, but it's a big step toward helping new players get into the game more smoothly.    [/p][p][/p][h2]New Skins & Achievements[/h2][p]
We’ve added a [b]ton of new achievements[/b]—check the in-game achievement page for the full list!


[b]Skins are now achievement-locked![/b]  Unlock new cosmetics by progressing in the game.[/p][h3]New Skins:[/h3][list][*][p][b]Elemental Pieces[/b] & [b]Stone Chessboard[/b]          [/p][list][*][p] Features a [b]Dynamic Chessboard[/b] that reacts to gameplay events      [/p][/*][*][p]Fully animated skin        [/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257659/b897bb925e1f9b5b6c858eef4f70bfcb42c5a623.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Sketchy Pieces[/b] & [b]Glass Chessboard[/b]          [/p][list][*][p]Unique hand-drawn art style      [/p][/*][*][p]Also fully animated         [/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257659/cff7d4c75b0a26f7b78e18cf8f675edf115065a4.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Steam Lobby Integration[/h2][h3]
See what your [b]Steam friends[/b] are doing in ChessBlaze  [/h3][h3][b]Invite them directly[/b]—they don’t even need to have the game open!

[/h3][h2]Bug Fixes... A LOT of Bug Fixes[/h2][h3]
We've squashed a [u][b]lot[/b][/u] of bugs in this update:[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed server connection issues  [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed lobby-breaking bug after unexpected disconnects  [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Steam profile pictures crashing the game  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed [b]Slime Piece[/b] textures  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed numerous [b]Pre-move[/b] bugs  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed bug where captured moving pieces could glitch  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Resolution settings now [b]actually apply correctly[/b]  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed AI freezing in [b]Single-player[/b]  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed [b]random victory screens[/b]  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed bug where [b]new players couldn't play Single-player[/b] [b]before trying Multiplayer[/b]   [/p][/*][/list][h3]many bugs still await unnoticed, thats why before releasing version 1.3, bug fixes updates will also be released[/h3][p][/p][h2]Final Note[/h2][p][/p][p]ChessBlaze doesn’t yet have a huge player base, but we’re hoping this update will start changing that. We truly appreciate everyone who continues to support the game! [/p][p][/p][h2]Coming in 1.3 (Autumn Release)[/h2][h3]Here’s what you can look forward to in the next update:    [/h3][list][*][p]Complete [b]Gameplay UI Redesign,[/b]  [b]Ranked System,[/b]  New skins, achievements and game modes  [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Rotating Quickplay Mode[/b] – a special game mode that changes weekly!  [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Thank you for playing ChessBlaze and stay tuned for the next updates![/b]  [/p]

notes.title: ChessBlaze Update 1.1 Released
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce that the first major content update for ChessBlaze is now live!
New Content:

[b]Singleplayer Mode![/b]
After the release, we realized how crucial singleplayer is to players. This update introduces AI with multiple difficulty levels for the Classic game mode. Other game modes will receive their singleplayer versions in the future — so stay tuned!

[b]New Skins for Pieces and Chessboard[/b]
•	Sketchy Chessboard
•	Pixel Pieces

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257659/026d25eb8c770e481b45c68ddcea91941cc7004b.png[/img]

[b]Many Bug Fixes[/b]
The initial release had tons of minor bugs — this update hopefully fixes them all.
•	Fixed server connection issues
•	Fixed an error where the pawn didn’t always change texture to the queen after promotion
•	Fixed issues with selecting game modes in custom matches
•	Checking the king now triggers a sound effect, so you won’t be so easily surprised by checkmate
•	Added and fixed a few Steam achievements
